Item 1: The builder brief names test/csv.test.js and says "Keep the existing tests." It also says to "Leave src/parse.js alone unless you need to change it, and if you do, don't change how it handles CSV." Item 2: Verifier check 6 runs "npm test; echo "exit=$?"", not `npm run test:cli`. Its advisory says plainly: "The issue's proof for check 6 names `npm run test:cli`, but package.json defines only a `test` script. Check 6 uses `npm test`, as its expect line says."
